## Progress

- Merged [PR #1](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/1): Medvya.sln, .NET 10 pinned, Host.Api /health, Identity/Tenancy/Audit modules, pnpm workspace, web/clinic, packages/ui, AGENTS.md

## Description

Create the repository layout agreed in ADR-001: Medvya.sln with src/Host.Api, src/BuildingBlocks/*, src/Modules/<Module>/{Domain,Application,Infrastructure,Api} for the P0 modules (Identity, Tenancy, Audit), src/Workers/Worker.Jobs, web/clinic, web/portal (placeholder), packages/{ui,api-client,i18n,test-fixtures}, tests/*, infra/bicep, docs, tools.
Pin the .NET 10 SDK (global.json), central package management (Directory.Packages.props), nullable + warnings-as-errors + analyzers (Directory.Build.props), pnpm workspaces for web/* and packages/*.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given a fresh clone, when I run `dotnet build` and `pnpm install && pnpm -r build`, then both succeed with zero warnings.
- [ ] **AC2.** The folder layout matches docs/03-architecture/repository-structure.md for every folder needed in P0; later modules are not created yet.
- [ ] **AC3.** global.json pins a .NET 10 SDK; Directory.Packages.props holds every NuGet version; no project file contains a version number.
- [ ] **AC4.** web/clinic starts with `pnpm --filter clinic dev` on React 19 + TypeScript + Vite and renders a placeholder page using packages/ui.
- [ ] **AC5.** README.md explains prerequisites, local start and links to docs/; AGENTS.md states the synthetic-data-only and no-PHI-in-logs rules.

## Test notes

- CI job builds the solution and the web workspace on a clean runner.
